An '''avian native''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], this creature had a bulbous body and translucent, pale skin.<ref name=":0" />

One of these avians took flight in front of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] during her reconnaissance<ref name=":0">{{Film|III}}</ref> en route to [[Niango/Legends|Niango]]. The flying creature caught Aayla Secura's eye,<ref name="BF">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/bts/production/f20060807/index.html|text=Building Felucia}}</ref> thus leaving her unable to defend herself when [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly]] and his [[327th Star Corps/Legends|troops]] opened fire, cutting her down in accordance with [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].<ref name=":0" />

[[File:Gummy_felucian_bird.jpg|thumb|A Felucian bird which distracts Aayla before her death]]

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Late in the development of the sequence George decided he wanted to add the equivalent of a flying bird into the sequence. We ended up recycling a creature from one of the other sequences -- a peko peko. We then took a Felucia glass/GummiBear shader and applied it to the bird's geometry so we would have this gelatinous flying bird thing. You're still using the same textures but with a weird translucent characteristic on top of it.|Computer Graphics Supervisor [[Patrick Myers]] describes the origin of the Felucian bird.|<ref name="BF" />}}
Since the CGI model for this creature was created using the existing [[Peko-peko/Legends|peko peko]] model from [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|Episode I]],<ref name="DB-Felucia ground beetle">{{DB|creature|feluciagroundbeetle|Felucia ground beetle}}</ref> and filling it with the same blue substance in the body of a [[Gelagrub/Legends|gelagrub]], Star Wars Insider refers to this species as the "gummy peko peko," but this is probably just a production nickname and not necessarily an in-universe name.
